parameters.name: Domain
parameters.description:
The domain name of the website to query.

> The domain name must have a website forwarding rule configured. You can call [DescribeDomains](~~91724~~) to query all domain names that have website forwarding rules configured.

parameters.name: InstanceIds
parameters.description: The IDs of the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instances to query.

parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description: The page number in paging. Set the current page number. Default value: **1**.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of forwarding rules per page in paging. Set the number of entries on each page. Valid values: **1** to **10**.

parameters.name: QueryDomainPattern
parameters.description:
The query match mode. Valid values:
- **fuzzy** (default): fuzzy match.
- **exact**: exact match.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description:
The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Pro or Anti-DDoS Premium instance belongs in Resource Management.

If you do not set this parameter, the instance belongs to the default resource group.
